eight-ball.glb.title: 8-Ball (GLB)
eight-ball.glb.about: glTF binary exported from the Blender script: 160-segment sphere with custom equirect UVs and the generated decal texture embedded. Orbit it in the viewer.
eight-ball.glb.prompt: Export the procedurally textured 8-ball from Blender as a single GLB with its texture embedded, ready for three.js or model-viewer.

low-poly-island.glb.title: Low-Poly Island (GLB)
low-poly-island.glb.about: The generated island as glTF binary: terrain with vertex colours, props mesh with flat materials and a translucent water tile. Orbit it in the viewer.
low-poly-island.glb.prompt: Export the procedural low-poly island from Blender as one GLB with vertex colours and materials, ready for three.js.
